data.name: CHAOS - In the Darkness
data.detailed_description:
"From snow capped peaks of Njördiack to the wide, stretched lands of Ha-Dys, this country once full of promise was now in the grip of Chaos. Released from Deepholm by the felon god Methem, Chaos has spread to the world as a disease, devouring the souls of the peoples of the Silmerie.

In a final burst of courage, the armies of five kingdoms joined forces and swooped down on the ruins of Branilv at the heart of the region Ymar. This was where the world of Men had cracked, releasing Chaos from its jail of darkness. But brave warriors fought a too powerful enemy, indifferent to steel and fire. When the last of them finally died, the king Meldorian realized that the world was entering so dark times that the light itself will be forgotten. Secluded in the white stone fortress which overlook Rhianon, the proud city of Silme, he contemplated his kingdom one last time before that Chaos spreads its shadow on.

But although humanity seemed to prepare for death, the gods offered men a last present: the weapons to fight.
In a few days, the same stories began to travel throughout the Silmerie.

Thus, it was told that a disciple of Brohmar became in flames while praying and hadn't suffered any burns, or that a Paladin of Nerhacte had fully healed a dying person. In Agrimaar, a disciple of Aelien seemed able to completely disappear into the shadows while in Ha-Dys, a scribe of Stabia could freeze time within a few seconds! It was even said that a woman had resurrected her husband by praying Yshante.

The gods had offered to men some powers and extraordinary abilities, but for what purpose ?
To stand in the way of Chaos... and perhaps win ?

The story will tell.

Your story."

data.short_description: Chaos is an heroic fantasy RPG that immerses you in an war for survival of Silmeria and Gods themselves. Alone or with teamates, you will fight dread creatures to the depths of three dungeons, and then defeat the Avatar, a monstrous being, born from the power of Chaos.

reviews.review:
This is the worst full release game I think I've ever played.

Lets start with why. The game doesn't even run unless you drop your Java version back to 7. Then you have to hunt down a mysterious executable and then run that before you can even launch the game in Steam. So basically - it doesn't run. If you do happen to do this (which I did) you can get it to work - kinda.

Character creation is really more like character class selection. With 5 very basic types, Guardian, Warrior, Priest, Mage and Rogue types. No customization whatsoever. 

You start in a "lobby" of sorts? Its a very minimal castle type structure and the game tells you to go talk to some knight guy. This is probably where you'll start to regret your purchase. The keys are not by default bound to traditional WASD for movement - fine so I go to change them- and figure out that you cant change them in the UI at all. You have to enter commands in the chat window to rebind each key. UGH really? Fine, did that.

Now you talk to the knight guy and he tells you to go to the hall of prayers or some crap but doesnt tell you where it is or really even what to do once youre there. So you'll guess which portal it is after some trial and error then enter.

Its gets worse  - I couldnt figure out WTF was going on in this game whatsoever  - even after you get the controls bound, they are still stiff and unresponsive. Then you might also realize whats equipped on your character doesnt even show up on your avatar. My sword and Axe must be magic, invisible weapons yay!

I just cant go on about how bad this game is...especially if they think this is the full release. I've seen games in far better states in Alpha. Just avoid the headache.

Pros -
Creative Concept?
Made the devs some money?
Wasted 20 mins of solid bordom and replace it with sheer frustration.
Will make you more wary of buying random crap on Steam.

Cons -
Doesn't work well at all.
Bad Graphics.
Terrible Controls.
Not fun.
